notes: The marginal note ('Another reading is, to desire strong drink') was read and set aside under rule 38: the printed text governs, so the italic 'to say' is what is aligned.
Variant WLC.PRO.31.4.v001 resolved to r00-base, which supplies s015 אֵי; the projection is taken as given under rule 9, and the unit is not marked FALLBACK EXCLUDED, so rule 53 does not apply.

The two 'It is' frames are divided as rules 20 and 49 direct: the construction-supplied copula joins the לְ heading the prepositional predicate, and the impersonal/extraposed 'It' is added, rule 20 naming a cleft or impersonal 'it' as licensed by no morpheme. The competing reading takes 'It is' as one supplied frame on the preposition.
The italic 'to say' supplies a lexical verb for a line whose Hebrew writes none, so rule 34's gapping clause does not cover it and it is added under rule 20's supplied-lexical-verb clause.
'strong drink' heads on 'strong' by rule 31's subtraction; the competing head is 'drink' read as the class noun, and the same choice was taken at PRO.31.6.
